$comment: Cache, not authority. Recover it by searching Confluence under rootPageId and Jira for the syncLabel. DRIFT DETECTION IS BROKEN AND THIS NOTE IS THE ONLY RECORD OF WHY. The vendored skill says compare a hash of the remote body; the local amendment says compare the Confluence version number. This connector supports neither: getConfluencePage returns no version field and no raw body hash worth comparing, because local files are Markdown and Confluence stores its own format. updateConfluencePage DOES return the new version, which is where remoteVersion below comes from, so a version can be written but not read back. Until that changes, the usable signal is the page's lastModified against lastSyncedAt here: if a page changed later than we wrote it, a human edited it. Show the divergence and ask; do not overwrite.
